spots.name: Boundary Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 4,007 m (13,147 ft).

spots.name: Boundary Peak Wilderness
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.
